definitions.explanation: Regular, repeated movement or pattern, especially in music, dance, biology, or nature. Emphasizes the regularity and cyclical nature of the motion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{律動|りつどう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: I surrendered myself to the rhythm of the waves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{律動|りつどう}し⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: My body naturally started moving rhythmically to the music.

notes:
Composed of {律|りつ} (law; rule; rhythm) and {動|どう} (movement). Describes movement characterized by regularity and repetition, whether biological, musical, or natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {律動的|りつどうてき}: rhythmic; rhythmical
- {律動|りつどう}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: rhythmic exercise
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{律動|りつどう}: heartbeat rhythm
- {律動|りつどう}⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧: rhythmic gymnastics/calisthenics

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧: rhythm — the loanword is far more common in everyday speech and music contexts
- ⟦{拍動|はくどう}→拍動：26245_hakudou⟧: pulsation; beating — specifically refers to the beating of the heart or pulse, more medical
- ⟦{鼓動|こどう}→鼓動：19609_kodou⟧: heartbeat; throbbing — poetic or literary term for the beating of the heart
- {韻律|いんりつ}: meter; prosody — refers to rhythm in poetry and verse
